resources.string: A new main-view button shows or hides the reticle and point callouts, remembering your choice.
Photo and panorama labels keep their own settings, independently of the live reticle.
Search, filters and sorting run in the background for a more responsive object list.
Optional row loading waits until scrolling stops; ready thumbnails remain visible.
A translucent black backing improves contrast for app-generated celestial symbols.
A centered circular indicator follows the day/night theme while the initial list is prepared.
